description: Create a shareable public preview URL for a port in a sandbox. The sandbox must have inbound networking enabled (create it with allow_inbound).

expires_at.description: Optional RFC-3339 timestamp at which the preview URL auto-expires. Omit to keep it until the sandbox ends.

port.description: The TCP port inside the sandbox to create a preview URL for (1-65535).

session_id.description: The sandbox session serving the port.

slug.description: Subdomain slug for the preview URL (3-63 chars, lowercase letters/digits/hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen).

name: tenki_create_preview_url
